lyrics:
[Intro: pulsing synth bass, glassy pad, distant surf]

[Verse 1: airy, clear female voice]
Four-twelve, they gave us the same key
Same balcony, same strip of sea
The lamp's been changed, the chairs are new
The moon is where we left it, too

[Chorus: four-on-the-floor kick, wide synths, voice doubled]
Room with the same view
Twenty years, and it still knows you
Room with the same view
We've changed more than the sea's had to
Stand here where we stood
It still looks good
Room with the same view

[Verse 2: bass busier, voice warmer]
You had more hair, I had less doubt
We thought we had it figured out
We didn't, and we're here again
I'd take us now over us then

[Chorus: four-on-the-floor kick, wide synths, voice doubled]
Room with the same view
Twenty years, and it still knows you
Room with the same view
We've changed more than the sea's had to
Stand here where we stood
It still looks good
Room with the same view

[Bridge: drums drop out, voice and pad]
Same view
Different eyes
Same view

[Outro: synth bass pulsing, surf, a balcony door sliding]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 118 BPM, 4/4, B minor rising to D major in the chorus. Cinematic, cool and tender.

VOICE: Female, airy and clear, light vibrato, cool in the verses and open in the choruses, where she is doubled. Almost whispered in the bridge.

INSTRUMENTS: A pulsing synth bass, glassy pads, wide, cinematic synth chords, a four-on-the-floor kick with a soft clap, a delayed guitar line, a rising white-noise sweep, distant surf, a sliding door.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, bass pulse. 0:18 Verse 1. 0:50 Chorus 1. 1:26 Verse 2. 1:58 Chorus 2. 2:34 Bridge, drums out. 2:54 Outro, bass and surf, a door at 3:30.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2020 Australian cinematic electronic pop: wide, cool and polished, voice bright and close, bass pulsing under everything.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'I'd take us now over us then' at 1:52, leading into the second chorus.

STATION FIT: Saturday, 10:30 p.m. A wide, cool vocal track for the balcony after dinner.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Surprised, remembering, honest, glad.
